body:
## Problem

"confirm" messages should go to the ui2 dialog window next to the confirmation prompt in the cmdline. This is normally the case, but when a `kind="empty"` message is processed, it leaves the messaging system in a state such that if the next message is `kind="confirm"`, it is incorrectly sent to the "msg" window. 

If default target is set to "cmd", this does not happen.  

## Steps to reproduce

1. create a minimal `init.lua` (the inputlist keymap is just for convenience of generating a confirm message)
```lua
require("vim._core.ui2").enable({
  msg = { targets = "msg" }
})

vim.keymap.set({"n"}, "<Enter>", function()
  vim.fn.inputlist({
    " item 1 ",
    " item 2 ",
    " item 3 "
  })
end)
```

2. emit a `kind="confirm"` message after doing something that causes a `kind="empty"` message to be processed

for example
```
nvim --clean -u init.lua
```
then
- `:` to enter cmdline
- `<Esc>` to abort and send empty message
- `<Enter>` to open a confirm message (in this case an `inputlist`)
- see that the confirm content is not in the dialog window


Here's a video demonstration

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/60e364bc-f360-4030-8ad0-3672e4035d1f

## Expected behavior

Confirm messages belong in the dialog window next to the confirmation prompt. Concretely, `kind="confirm"` message should be routed to "dialog" in the case outline above

## System info

- Nvim version (nvim -v): `v0.13.0-dev-1758 gb4528ba65c` neovim/neovim@b4528ba65c
- Vim (not Nvim) behaves the same?: ?
- Operating system/version: Linux 7.1.12-100.fc43.x86_64
- Terminal name/version: ghostty 1.3.1-4.fc43
- $TERM environment variable: `xterm-ghostty`
- Installation: built from source `make CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$HOME/opt/nvim && make install`

comment_data.body:
some additional context:

I asked Opus 5 to find where this behavior was introduced and it came back with de67f93aeaa24165cd344ae2d8854713d2b78a1c

Opus 5 says it has something to do with `msg_ext_fast` being left set to `false`, "so the next prompt's message reaches the message UI before the prompt exists and is shown in the wrong window", but I don't really know much `c` and I don't want to assert anything I have a vague understanding of. 

What I CAN deduce from my debugging though, is - 
- In a normal scenario, `cmdline_show` fires first which causes `ui.cmd.prompt` to be `true` by the time `msg_show` dispatches the content to a target.
- When a `kind="empty"` message is processed, `ui.cmd.prompt` is `false` for the next confirm message at the moment `msg_show` is called, which means it falls through to default target

Here are a couple demo debug sessions

<details>
<summary>This shows the normal, expected path</summary>

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d51d57ef-cd44-4316-a680-06ba231aaa89

</details>

<details>
<summary>Here I am emitting an empty message, and then doing the confirm message. `ui.cmd.prompt` is `false` in this case _for whatever reason_. It seems like `cmdline_show` is being called after `msg_show` in this case</summary>

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/cbfd0d3d-376e-48b7-8e65-c2e810b56448

</details>


Hopefully that adds some useful information
